source: hand-written: W3.4, in the shape of messages-404-unknown-user.json: Exchange's ErrorItemNotFound for a message no longer there. Never seen live: the live cleaner test of 2026-10-02 sent a permanentDelete twice and Exchange answered the second 403 ErrorCannotDeleteObject (w34-mail-permanentdelete-403-cannotdeleteobject-repeat.json), not 404. Kept for a message deleted by someone else between the Cleaner's listing and its permanentDelete (or GET), and as the 404 of the GET remove() sends after that 403 (W3.4 build notes point 15)
